steps.name: Step 1 — Navigate to the pipeline; canvas is displayed
Step 2 — Click the 'State' button; the STATE panel opens
Step 3 — STATE panel shows a close (X) button
Step 4 — Default variables 'input'/'messages' are listed, each with a checked toggle and NO delete control
Step 5 — Click '+' to add a new state variable; a name input appears
Step 6 — Enter variable name 'custom_output' and commit via Enter
Step 7 — Click the type button (default 'Abc'/String); dropdown shows exactly String/Number/List/Json
Step 8 — Select String (keep the pre-selected type); verify String type is retained
Step 9 — Verify 'custom_output' appears in the STATE panel list
Step 10 — Save the pipeline; verify no console errors and a 201 Created response
